title: J4: MIMI role to JMAP admin/member rule
description: JMAP group chats have only admin/member. Recommended: admin if the user's MIMI role holds any membership or metadata capability; optionally read-only ChatMember.mimiRole {index, name}; banned users omitted from members; ChatMember.active for inactive participants. PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
notes: DECIDED: JMAP role 'admin' if the user's MIMI role holds any of canAddParticipant, canRemoveParticipant, canKick, canChangeUserRole, canBan, canUnban, or any room-policy-04 §8.2 metadata capability (room name, description, avatar, subject, mood); else 'member'. Banned users (role 1) and role 0 are omitted from members. No mimiRole/active fields (not in base; no INVENTED decision). joinedAt = the hub accepted timestamp of the commit that added the user (MIMI defines no join time). The role is a UI hint only; hub room policy authorizes. (The bead's earlier rule, any membership capability, is rejected: self-only capabilities would make everyone admin.)
